messages:
sabrina: heads up — production alert from AcmeCorp: p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~110ms to ~420ms after last runtime build
kai: ack. rolling logs now. which model and region?
sabrina: rtx-pool-1, gpt-neo-ops-13b, us-west-2. customer attached traces showing large kernel launch stalls around attention kernel
eng-runtime-bot: alert created: INC-2029, tags: latency,p99,attention-kernel
kai: looking at perf aggregates — p95 went 120ms->300ms, p99 110->420. CPU & mem normal. KV-cache hit rates unchanged. hypothesis: new FlashAttention compile flags landed in build 2029
amar: confirmed change in compile matrix: FLASHATTN_OPTIM=ON, SDPA_FALLBACK=auto in 2029
sabrina: customer issue started ~2029-03-12T03:00Z which aligns
kai: repro locally:
```
python bench/serve_bench.py --model gpt-neo-ops-13b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --tokens 512 --use-flashattn true
```
results: kernel launch overhead spikes, higher variance on p99
amar: experiment: force SDPA vs force Flash; can we flip per-deployment?
oncall-sre: yes — rollout manager supports kernel_override=sdpa|flash for pools
devx: added kernel_override flag and spun up rtx-pool-1-canary
sabrina: routed canary -> sdpa. p99 on canary dropped to ~130ms in 2min :thumbsup:
kai: confirmed. flash mode p99 stays ~420ms. points to FlashAttention variant regression
amar: likely compile change introduced extra per-launch overhead at seq=1024. bisect between builds 2028 and 2029
kai: mitigation plan: 1) route affected customers to sdpa via kernel_override 2) roll back FLASHATTN_OPTIM in next build until fixed 3) add perf unit test in CI for seq=1024 p99 threshold
sabrina: routed AcmeCorp to sdpa and updated support ticket — customer reports improvement
oncall-sre: rolling kernel_override to all affected slots in prod region
amar: bisect plan: build-A=2028 baseline, build-B=2029 with FLASHATTN_OPTIM=ON. I'll collect nvprof and PTX diffs
kai: capture kernel launch time, kernel duration, cudaDriverApi time, dynamic shared mem size, nvprof output, repro script
amar: nvprof: extra cudaLaunch ~2.3ms per attention kernel in flash mode vs 0.2ms sdpa for seq=1024
devx: PR to gate FLASHATTN_OPTIM behind runtime feature-flag so we can enable per-customer: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4123
sabrina: next steps: keep sdpa override for AcmeCorp until fix, run bisect, get patch, validate perf job then re-enable behind feature flag. update status page
kai: follow-ups: add perf unit (p99 <=200ms seq=1024 b=4), telemetry metric kernel_launch_latency, schedule postmortem
amar: starting bisect now. will post findings.
sabrina: thanks team. ping if emergency rollback needed
eng-runtime-bot: incident INC-2029 transitioned to mitigated by oncall-sre
